timeline: You rely on safety protocols today, but in 1944 Bombay, firefighters poured water onto boiling explosives without knowing the ship was about to vanish.
Fourteen hundred tons of explosives sat in the hold.
Then a small fire broke out deep inside.
Firefighters poured tons of water onto the flames.
The water began boiling from the trapped heat.
At sixteen sixteen the ship was torn apart by a massive explosion.
Windows shattered twelve kilometers away across the city.
Eighty thousand residents lost their homes overnight.
And thirty-one crates of gold bullion were scattered across the harbor.
You probably think the 1944 Bombay dock disaster was just an ammunition accident, but cotton bales and oil were packed right beside the explosives.
